# Mocter

> Mocter is an AI automation platform that runs customer support, appointment scheduling and sales over WhatsApp, from the business's own WhatsApp number.

Mocter (by IdenTechnology, Colombia) automatically answers customer conversations on WhatsApp in natural language, books appointments with Google Calendar and Google Meet confirmations, manages orders and quotes, delivers multimedia such as catalogs and PDFs, and classifies every contact into a sales pipeline (cold, warm, hot lead, order, delivered). A unified inbox shows each conversation with AI-generated labels, priority and context, and a human can take over any chat at any time.

- Public site: https://mocter.co/es (Spanish, default) and https://mocter.co/en (English)
- Sectors served: clinics, salons and spas, consultancies, real estate, education, technical services, e-commerce, agencies, restaurants, gyms
- Data residency: all customer data is hosted on servers in Colombia
- Contact: info@identechnology.co / WhatsApp +57 322 275 2524
